Please note that processing interventions for prisoners often requires a long period of time as the IPS isnt cooperative or responsive. As a result many cases remain unresolved even if a single request gets approved. For example a prisoner who suffers from a chronic disease might receive his medicine following our intervention but he might still find himself not receiving his medicine regularly.
